description.value: Copes' Islander is a family-run oceanfront B&B on the Comox Peninsula of Vancouver Island, operated by hosts Mike and Patti since 1996, with direct beach access and sweeping views of the ocean and Coast Mountains. The property sits minutes from the Comox (Little River) BC Ferries terminal, making it a convenient stop for cyclists travelling between Vancouver Island and the Sunshine Coast. Patti's elaborately prepared breakfasts are a noted highlight of the stay.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and confirms the OSM phone number (250-339-1038), address (1484 Wilkinson Rd, Comox), and property type as an oceanfront B&B operating since 1996. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly stated on the front page ('Wireless Internet - free WiFi access'). No mention of bike storage, e-bike charging, laundry, or any other cyclist-specific facility appears anywhere in the website content; 'biking' appears only as a regional activity link in the site navigation, not a hosted service.
concerns: Website copyright footer reads '2001-2010', suggesting the site has not been updated in over a decade; currency of all amenity information is uncertain.
OSM name uses 'Copes\' Islander Bed & Breakfast' while the website consistently brands the property as 'Copes Islander Oceanfront B&B' (no apostrophe-s, addition of 'Oceanfront').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active accommodation in a prime cycling corridor near the Comox ferry terminal, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from the website. Direct outreach is needed before inclusion.

wow_evidence: family-run oceanfront B&B...operated by hosts Mike and Patti since 1996

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: long-running oceanfront B&B near Comox ferry; $140-180
